
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

capm_data <- read_excel("CAPM.xlsx")

sizes = c(1, 2, 9, 10)

for(i in sizes) {
  size_col_name <- paste0("size", i)
  val_col_name <- paste0("val", i)
  capm_data[[paste0("excess_", size_col_name)]] <- capm_data[[size_col_name]] - capm_data$rf
  capm_data[[paste0("excess_", val_col_name)]] <- capm_data[[val_col_name]] - capm_data$rf
}

# Run CAPM regression with robust standard errors
for(i in sizes) {
  excess_size_col_name <- paste0("excess_size", i)
  
  capm_model_size <- lm(formula = paste(excess_size_col_name, "~ rmrf"), data = capm_data)
  
  summary_robust_size <- coeftest(capm_model_size, vcov. = vcovHC(capm_model_size, type = "HC0"))
  
  cat("Results for", excess_size_col_name, ":\n")
  print(summary_robust_size)
  cat("\n")
}

for(i in sizes) {
  excess_val_col_name <- paste0("excess_val", i)
  
  capm_model_val <- lm(formula = paste(excess_val_col_name, "~ rmrf"), data = capm_data)
  
  summary_robust_val <- coeftest(capm_model_val, vcov. = vcovHC(capm_model_val, type = "HC0"))
  
  cat("Results for", excess_val_col_name, ":\n")
  print(summary_robust_val)
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
capm_data$SMB <- capm_data$size1 - capm_data$size10 
capm_data$HML <- capm_data$val10 - capm_data$val1  

# Fama-French three-factor model
for(i in sizes) {
  excess_size_col_name <- paste0("excess_size", i)
  
  ff_model_size <- lm(formula = paste(excess_size_col_name, "~ rmrf + SMB + HML"), data = capm_data)

  summary_robust_ff_size <- coeftest(ff_model_size, vcov. = vcovHC(ff_model_size, type = "HC0"))
  
  cat("Results for", excess_size_col_name, ":\n")
  print(summary_robust_ff_size)
  cat("\n") 
}

for(i in sizes) {
  excess_val_col_name <- paste0("excess_val", i)
  
  ff_model_val <- lm(formula = paste(excess_val_col_name, "~ rmrf + SMB + HML"), data = capm_data)

  summary_robust_ff_val <- coeftest(ff_model_val, vcov. = vcovHC(ff_model_val, type = "HC0"))
  
  cat("Results for", excess_val_col_name, ":\n")
  print(summary_robust_ff_val)
  cat("\n")
}
```
